focus: canonical alias reconciliation and station-level tariff classification

findings.result: ESH and GAS are legacy aliases of the current UAU/Uattzy operator and must not be counted as independent current CPOs
findings.reason: first-party FAQ displays tariff per connector and states price/additional fees may vary by power, duration and bay occupation; third-party eMSP pricing is explicitly separate
findings.resume: capture deterministic legacy/current EVSE -> Uattzy native connector tariff mapping

notes: No historical E-Shore/GASGAS price was inherited.
No eMSP tariff was promoted as direct Uattzy pricing.
Unique consolidated physical station count was not inferred by summing constituent partyId station counts.
